name: release-1.31.10
body:
[nginx-1.31.10](https://nginx.org/en/download.html) mainline version has been released, with a fix for [excessive CPU usage](https://nginx.org/en/security_advisories.html) vulnerability when using ssl_early_data (CVE-2026-132779).

## What's Changed
* Version bump by @pluknet in https://github.com/nginx/nginx/pull/2003


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nginx/nginx/compare/release-1.31.9...release-1.31.10
